name: Port, Fortresses and Group of Monuments, Cartagena
description: Cartagena is a Spanish colonial port on Colombia's Caribbean coast, founded in 1533 and ringed by the most extensive fortifications in South America. Behind the thick walls, three old quarters unfold: San Pedro, with its cathedral and Andalusian-style palaces, merchant-built San Diego, and working-class Gethsemani. The forts once shielded this rich trading harbour from pirates and rival navies.
